description.value: Years of climbing collapsed parking structures and gutted towers taught you where wreckage holds weight. You don't take a circumstance penalty to Climb checks on unstable rubble or debris the way an untrained climber would.

cinderfall.incomplete: The Climb penalty removal is gated on 'unstable rubble or debris', an environmental condition with no roll-option hook: pf2e's terrain roll options come from a closed environmentTypes enum (aquatic/arctic/desert/forest/mountain/plains/swamp/underground/urban; pf2e-source/src/module/scene/region-behavior/environment.ts:16-20, StringField choices restricted to that list) that has none of Cinderfall's wasteland terrain, and there is no GM-facing way to add to it. Real Rock Runner's own terrain:stone/terrain:earth predicate values aren't in that enum either, confirming this is a closed system, not a GM-extensible one.
